detailed_descriptions.en: Alric's father descended into the ruins beneath the city years ago. He never came back. Sunken Realms is a dungeon crawling adventure about a son who goes looking for answers. Descend into an abandoned underground city, battle monsters, collect materials, craft your gear, and master forgotten spells. Grow stronger. Go deeper. Find out what happened down there — and whether the truth is worth what it costs. No open world. No battle pass. Just a sword, a dungeon, and a question that won't let you go Features: • Hand-crafted rooms are procedurally re-arranged every time you enter the dungeon so you'll never play the same layout twice • Fluid Melee and Ranged combat • Learn spells to wield powerful, long-forgotten magic • Collect gold and crafting materials from vanquished foes and treasure chests • Return to camp to craft weapons, cook food, brew potions, trade, and upgrade your character • A heartfelt, personal story that unfolds between two friends around the campfire between runs • Immersive, original score

Alric's father descended into the ruins beneath the city years ago. He never came back.

Sunken Realms is a dungeon crawling adventure about a son who goes looking for answers. • Learn spells to wield powerful, long-forgotten magic

• Collect gold and crafting materials from vanquished foes and treasure chests

• Return to camp to craft weapons, cook food, brew potions, trade, and upgrade your character

• A heartfelt, personal story that unfolds between two friends around the campfire between runs

• Immersive, original score
